name: TMC2209 stepstick
description: 16-pin TMC2209 stepstick in standalone STEP/DIR. Viewed from above with the headers on the long sides: left column top to bottom EN, MS1, MS2, PDN_UART, PDN_UART, CLK, STEP, DIR; right column top to bottom VM, GND, 2B, 2A, 1A, 1B, VIO, GND (BIGTREETECH V1.2/V1.3 silkscreen).
notes: Breadboard footprint is a 2x8 header, 0.1 inch along the length and 0.6 inch between the two rows, so it straddles a solderless breadboard from row b to row f. Pin names must be unique, so the two PDN_UART pins are PDN_UART (header pin 4, the factory UART pin) and PDN_UART_ALT (pin 5), and the two GND pins are VMGND (top right, next to VM) and IOGND (bottom right, next to VIO); the breadboard renderer prints the silkscreen text for all four. 2B/2A/1A/1B are the silkscreen M2B/M2A/M1A/M1B; the BIGTREETECH manual table calls the same positions A2, A1, B1, B2. MS1 and MS2 both at VIO is 1/16. VM is the motor supply (the 5V role is the nearest PinViz power role; label it 24 V in the diagram).
